_note: What's hurting (or helping) a hole's health and happiness, cause by cause (F-018; src/sim/diagnosis.ts). health: what drains the hole's health meter, by the keys of population.healthDrain. happiness: the parts of every home's noise, comfort and wellbeing (happiness.ts homeParts), plus afterglow, events and base. text says what it is, fix what to do about it (left out where there's nothing to do). Placeholders: {met} a need's % met, {pct} the air's %, {health} the hole's health, {homes} how many homes feel it ('1 home', '3 homes'). homesFrom: the least a home's part (in points) must cost it to count as feeling it. label: the part's short name in a home's breakdown ('view +1'). field: the neighbour effect behind it, whose source rooms the home panel and the "Why?" panel name. shared: felt by everyone alike, so the "Why?" panel has nothing to Show me. factors: the happiness factors' names, in the Trends band and the home panel; mood is the afterglow and recent events, felt by all.

water.label: water
water.text: Water: people get {met}% of what they need
water.fix: More water: a water recycler for the gray water, a deep well pump, or bigger water tanks.

meals.label: meals
meals.text: Meals: people get {met}% of what they need
meals.fix: People eat only cooked meals: a galley or kitchen cooks raw food (from farms) or Earth rations into them.

sanitation.label: sanitation
sanitation.text: Sanitation: {met}% of people have a restroom
sanitation.fix: Build restrooms near the homes, or homes with their own bathroom.

o2.label: thin oxygen
o2.fix: More oxygen: an electrolyzer (it needs water and power), a CO2 scrubber, or farms.

co2.label: CO2
co2.fix: A CO2 scrubber, or farms to breathe it in. Both need power.

holeHealth.label: hole's health
holeHealth.fix: See what's draining Health: water, meals, sanitation or the air.

noClinic.label: no clinic
noClinic.fix: Build a clinic within about 10 steps of the homes, or a bigger one.

ordinanceHealth.label: ordinances
ordinanceHealth.fix: Check the ordinances in the office.

ordinanceComfort.label: ordinances
ordinanceComfort.fix: Check the ordinances in the office.

schooling.label: schooling
schooling.fix: A school within reach of the homes.

grief.label: grief
grief.text: Grief for the dead with no resting place
grief.fix: A crypt to lay them to rest.

noSeat.label: no galley seat
noSeat.text: No seat at a galley within reach: {homes}
noSeat.fix: A galley or canteen near the homes, or a bigger one.

noRestroom.label: no restroom
noRestroom.fix: Restrooms within 6 steps of the homes.

ownComfort.label: the home itself
ownComfort.text: The homes themselves (bunk dorms are cramped; studios, flats and suites roomy)
ownComfort.fix: Roomier homes: studios, flats or suites rather than bunk dorms.

neighbourComfort.label: neighbours
neighbourComfort.fix: Keep homes away from industry and next to parks and canteens.

smell.label: smell
smell.fix: Smell rides the corridors: a bulkhead on the corridor between smelly rooms (galleys, farms, composters, recycling) and the homes stops it, and so does distance.

noise.label: noise
noise.fix: Move noisy rooms away from homes, or put a corridor between them. Quiet hours (an ordinance) halve it.

airQuality.label: stale air
airQuality.fix: Stale air rides the corridors too: a bulkhead keeps it in with the industry (smelters). A ventilation hub or green space freshens it; outer rings are staler.

crowding.label: crowding
crowding.fix: More homes, so fewer people share each one.

neighbourHealth.label: neighbours
neighbourHealth.fix: Keep homes away from industry and near clinics.
